I am a huge fan of Bahubali franchise! Those films literally made Prabhas my
crush, who obviously doesn't know I exist 😂 I expected a lot out of Saaho,
Prabhas's next 350-crore budget film. It is a dull affair. The reviews blamed
the story and script. What I loved the most about Bahubali was the magic of
storytelling, narration and extraordinary direction. No movie has flopped
because of bad visuals or music. If they are bad, they are just seen as flaws.

and music, innumerable movies have flopped. Reason? Bad story, script,
screenplay or direction. A writer's role is huge here. Many small budget films
with new faces have been a huge hit and won awards. All thanks to the story,
script and the writer. These days, like top Vlogger Casey Neistat says, all
you need are a mobile phone and wi-fi connection to go viral! Apart from time
and lot of effort, I spend $0 on hashtag#fresherdiaries! The story and
strategy are all that matters! A bad content marketing strategy could prove
